name: Privacy
description: Coloured dots while the camera, microphone, screen or location is in use; hover shows which app

showCamera.description: Green dot while a PipeWire camera is captured

showMicrophone.description: Orange dot while a microphone is captured

showScreen.description: Red dot while recording (flag `recording`) or sharing the screen

showLocation.description: Blue dot while GeoClue reports location in use (needs geoclue)

ignore.description: Application or node names whose captures never light a dot

debugIpc.description: Test hook: expose IPC target haseen.privacy (summary of what the hover lists)
